blocks.orig: The Legendary Zanzibar Beach Resort lies on the Michamvi Peninsula on one of Zanzibar’s gorgeous east-coast beaches. It boasts 48 rooms (partly interconnected) with a tropical yet modern twist, featuring air conditioning, a private bathroom, and a relaxing patio overlooking either the garden or the sea. Legendary won’t let you get bored, as you can plunge into one of the two outdoor pools, step out onto the private beach, dive into the ocean, rent bikes to explore the surrounding village, stay active in the fully equipped gym, unwind with a book in the comfy lounge area, or play snooker, table tennis, and other games in the recreation area. When hunger strikes, you’ll find the restaurant under a beautiful, high, thatched ceiling, serving a menu with dishes from tropical Zanzibar to European to other flavours of the world. The resort is fully cashless, so a card is all you need for meals, drinks and bike rentals. A great place for those long, easy Zanzibar beach days…!
blocks.html: On the Michamvi Peninsula, set on one of the lovely beaches of Zanzibar’s east coast, you find the Legendary Zanzibar Beach Resort. The resort has 48 rooms (some of them interconnected), styled in a tropical yet modern way, each with air conditioning, a private bathroom and a relaxing patio looking out over the garden or the sea. There is always something to do at Legendary: take a dip in one of the two outdoor pools, walk onto the private beach, swim in the ocean, hire a bike to explore the village nearby, keep fit in the fully equipped gym, relax with a book in the comfortable lounge, or play snooker, table tennis and other games in the recreation area. When you get hungry, the restaurant sits beneath a beautiful high thatched ceiling and serves a menu ranging from tropical Zanzibar dishes to European food and other flavours from around the world. The resort is completely cashless, so you only need a card for meals, drinks and bike hire. A lovely base for long, relaxed beach days on Zanzibar…!
